_about: Maps each ## section of house-rules.md to the hook handler(s) in hooks/hooks.json, or verify.py case title fragment(s), that enforce it. A section mapped to [] must be listed in unenforced with a reason; a new rule with no check fails verify.py (#228).

unenforced.Open source first; paid is the last reso: a judgement about choosing tools; no hook or verify case can tell what was weighed
unenforced.Read the docs first, then check them aga: reading order is not observable; docs_drift.py only names drift at commit time, it does not enforce reading
unenforced.Build for a human working alone: a design stance for what gets built; nothing inspects the built output for it
unenforced.I say what prompted me, and I check the: announce and verdict report which agent and model ran, but nothing checks that a reply names what prompted it
unenforced.Nothing fails silently: verify.py cases test individual handlers for it, but no handler checks a session's own work for silent failure
unenforced.The user's hands are for decisions, not: a judgement about what to ask aj; no check can tell labour from a decision
unenforced.Deliver a whole workflow, not a starting: no check can tell a whole workflow from a starting point
unenforced.A shim that compiles is not proof the re: the evidence handler checks claims in general, nothing specific to compiler runs or UNTESTED: labels
unenforced.A reported update is not a completed one: versioncheck reports the installed version at session start but does not check a claimed update took effect
